Senior Software Developer – Node.js / React / TypeScript + DevOps – FinTech Scale-Up
Location:
Sydney (Hybrid – Mostly Remote)
Salary:
$170–190k + Super
Work Type:
Full Time – Permanent
Join a Scale-Up Building the Next Generation of FinTech Infrastructure
We’ve partnered exclusively with a product-led FinTech scale-up solving complex problems in the investment and compliance space. Their platform is already gaining strong market traction, and they’re now scaling the engineering team to support new greenfield builds, infrastructure improvements, and rapid customer growth.
This is a rare chance to join
early enough to make a real impact
, but late enough that the foundations are already stable, well-architected, and ready to grow.
The Stack
You’ll be working in a modern JavaScript/TypeScript environment:
Backend:
Node.js, TypeScript,
Express/NestJS
Frontend:
React.js,
Next.js,
TypeScript
, Tailwind
DevOps:
AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, CDK), Docker, CI/CD
Other:
GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Kafka (bonus), legacy PHP (bonus)
What You’ll Do
Own greenfield feature builds from architecture to release
Build scalable full-stack systems in a modern cloud-native environment
Improve infrastructure, CI/CD, and DevOps practices as part of a growing team
Collaborate with founders, designers, and product leaders in a tight-knit setup
Bring thoughtful technical input into both product and platform direction
What They’re Looking For
5+ years of experience in full-stack development, and Ideally 10+ years of software development experience
Proficiency in
Node.js, React.js, TypeScript
, and related tooling
Strong experience with
DevOps and cloud infrastructure
(ideally AWS – CDK, Docker, etc.)
Self-driven, delivery-focused, and comfortable in fast-moving teams
Bonus: experience in FinTech, RegTech, or compliance-heavy products
Why Join?
95% remote flexibility
, with optional team meetups in Sydney CBD
High-impact role with full ownership over your work
Small, high-performing team with minimal process and no red tape
Product with real traction, strong leadership, and technical excellence
Join a company building something truly unique in a growing market
Apply now
or contact us for a confidential chat — we’re exclusively recruiting this role and can give you insight into the team, stack, and culture.
Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a software developer?
Which of the following front end development libraries and frameworks are you proficient in?
How many years' experience do you have as a Node JS Developer?
How many years' experience do you have as a React Developer?
How many years' experience do you have in a DevOps role?
Don’t provide your bank or credit card details when applying for jobs.
